notes:
First CZ run 2026-11-02. 24 h (explicit on a page): Praha - Erika, IVET, AAVET, VETNEMO Libuš, Medicanima (night by phone arrangement), Pet-Medic (mobile emergency service), VetPark Praha 9 (only per Praha 11 city page); Český Brod - Vetnem ('24/7', weekend lunch break); Brno - Zvíře+, Seman, Hošek (own site unreachable; Veslařská 25b per Brnolove vs Gellnerova 8 per Avetum), VETUNI small-animal clinic ('non stop'); Olomouc - Mazoch (00-06 by phone); Ostrava - Nytra; Liberec - Hanychov (24-h phone, page also says 'do 22:00'); Trutnov - Horská veterinární klinika (24-h phone on-call, vet comes in), Veterinář s.r.o. ('Nepřetržitá pohotovost'); Jihlava - Okřina (single vet, not during holidays); plus TIS poison line. Not marked 24 h although close: Jaggy Brno and Jaggy Praha (17-09 weekdays + weekend nonstop), HANZA Hradec Králové (weekend nonstop), Mi-Vet Ústí (19-08 + weekend nonstop), VETINO Aesculap Pardubice (contradictory), Vetcentrum Stodůlky (to 24:00 then Pet-Medic), Veterina Helion (meta 'nonstop' but 20-22 hours), Růžodol Liberec (downgraded in the independent check: 24/7 only in the meta description, no visible hours or phone). Duty rotas: Czechia has no national or chamber-run rota; only Karlovarský kraj runs a region-funded weekend/holiday first-aid rota (14-17). Plzeň has no nonstop small-animal service (Zodiacus plans one with the city from 2027). Poison line: TIS Praha (+420 224 919 293 / 224 915 402, 24 h) explicitly handles poisonings of people and animals - added as poison_line. Left / unreachable: sos.vetkom.cz chamber emergency list (fetch blocked - next run should try it first, it may list all emergency workplaces); robots-disallowed: veterinakleisslova.cz (Plzeň, Kleisslova clinic - has emergency service), veterinar-vyskov.cz (VyVet, likely 24 h), veterinapraha.cz (VetPark), veterinarni-klinika-brno.com, veterinarni-klinika-praha.com, klinika-vltava.cz (České Budějovice), veterina-vimperk.cz; hosek-vet.cz redirect loop; kremenny.wixsite.com (Veterinární klinika Nisa Liberec, advertises nonstop) client error; veterinarninemocnice.cz (Hynar Opava) error; fvl.vfu.cz emergency page server error; aroundprague.cz client error; prague.eu rate-limited. Not yet covered: Opava (Hynar), Frýdek-Místek (AlfaVet), Třinec (Lískovka), Kolín (A.A.R.), Tachov, Lanškroun, Mikulov, ZooVET Hradec Králové, VETMED Ostrava, Brno ABClinic / VetPark Brno, Prachatice/Vimperk (Šumava), Špindlerův Mlýn, Liberec Nisa, Teplice/Most/Chomutov/Děčín, Mladá Boleslav, Kladno; Karlovy Vary rota practices could be added as clinics. Independent check 2026-11-02: opened every 24-h entry, the duty rota, the poison line and 7 random other clinics (seed 1102); all confirmed except Růžodol (downgraded); Hošek address set to Veslařská 25b; Nytra url removed (pointed to another practice's site).

Follow-up run 2026-11-02 (CZ follow-up): Follow-up run 2026-11-02.
